prompts.pistol: Create a CANDIDATE production sprite master for Meowcenary, a scrapyard animal roguelite. Use case: stylized-game-asset. Exact layout: three clearly separated full weapon sprites, one horizontal row of three equal-width cells, left to right T1, T2, T3. Genuine transparent background everywhere outside the weapons; no backdrop, checkerboard, shadows, typography, labels, grid lines, datum markers or other objects. Every gun points RIGHT, strict side view, barrel perfectly horizontal. Same lighting and receiver/grip alignment within each cell, equal physical scale across all three tiers; do not enlarge a copy for tier progression. Chunky crisp pixel-art sprites with strong dark outlines and large readable metal masses, charcoal/gunmetal, worn copper, cream wraps and small cyan energy accents. Preserve simplified mechanical scrapyard identity rather than realistic modern firearms. Structural upgrades must remain obviously different as monochrome silhouettes at 28px held and 44px rack icon size. Plenty of transparent margin around each whole gun and wide transparent separators. Each sprite is a single complete manufactured weapon, no floating attachments. Family identity comes before decorative detail. Draw the three tiers natively as different structures, not color swaps. Reference image only for existing game's worn metal/pixel style; do not copy board layout, datum guides or individual gun geometry. PISTOL FAMILY: shortest, compact pistol with short square scrap receiver, cream capped forward muzzle, compact rear angled worn wrapped grip. T1: single short core, simple small magazine integrated near grip. T2: retain T1 core identity but add a visibly PROTRUDING chunky cyan side-cell housing above the receiver, a stepped longer forward muzzle shroud and physically larger small magazine below front receiver. T3: broaden forward chamber with a large unmistakable open cutout, add an angular raised chamber bridge and thicker cream front cap; remain a compact pistol, no long stock or rifle barrel. Clear silhouette changes above and below core distinguish every adjacent tier.
